snippet.title: 「Senran Kagura 2: Deep Crimson」 Opening 「Beyond Light and Darkness」 《 Waifu2x | 4K 》
snippet.description:
High Quality Waifu2x AI Upscaled 「Senran Kagura 2: Deep Crimson」 OP/Opening.
Song: 「Hikari to Yami no Kanata」 (Beyond Light and Darkness) by 『Harada Hitomi & Imai Asami & Kobayashi Yuu & Mizuhashi Kaori & Iguchi Yuka』
Senran Kagura OPs: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLeaWyiQfGyfMZ64Ge6OrZ_ejL7x0u_ejg
Game: Senran Kagura 2: Deep Crimson
Source: bd-rip | 1080p
Upscaling process:
1. "Photoshop" "Camera Raw Filter" "Sharpening" ( Amount:50 | Radius:0.5 | Detail:100 | Masking:0 )
2. "waifu2x-ncnn-vulkan" ( -n 3 -s 1 )
3. ffmpeg encode:
3-1. ffmpeg -framerate "xx" -i "image%d.png" -c:v libx264 -crf 15 -s 3840x2160 -profile:v high444 -deblock -2:-1 -pix_fmt yuv444p -use_editlist 0 -movflags +faststart "video.mp4"
3-2. ffmpeg -i "audio-source" -c:a flac -ac 2 -ar 44100 "audio.flac"
3-3. ffmpeg -i "video.mp4" -i "audio.flac" -c copy -shortest -map 0:v -map 1:a -strict -2 "video-complete.mp4"
